scenes.title: Keep anchors and accent the additions

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Foundation Rhythm settings
steps.caption: Apply Foundation with P01 as the anchor. Add amount is 100 and Add accent is 70; the grid keeps steps 1–4 and adds steps 5 and 7.

steps.title: Hear protected notes and additions
steps.caption: Two loops emit MIDI pitches 60, 62, 64, 65, 60, 60. The four anchors retain velocities 127/117/107/97; both additions use 70.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: A two-cycle Build phrase
steps.caption: Apply Phrase length two with the Build curve. The first loop adds step 7; the next adds steps 5 and 7. Four complete loops prove the alternation and exact loop-relative timing.

scenes.title: Let each fragment keep its source notes

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Seed zero selects the sparse half
steps.caption: Size 4 splits an eight-step loop into two fragments. Seed 0 chooses P02 then P01, leaving only P02’s step-3 C at velocity 100. The original P01 note at that position is not averaged in.

steps.title: Change the saved seed
steps.caption: Select Seed 1 and apply. The first fragment now uses P01 and the second P02; lit steps are 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6.

steps.title: The source velocities survive
steps.caption: Two exact loops verify P01’s four authored notes and velocities, followed by P02’s step-6 C at 100.

scenes.title: Leave room around a leader’s anchors

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Choose channel two as leader
steps.caption: Apply CH02 with Window 0. Status is ON; the follower’s coincident step-5 addition is removed, while its anchors and step-7 addition remain.

steps.title: Only the coincidence is removed
steps.caption: Two exact loops verify follower steps 1–4 and 7 alongside the leader’s step 5, on separate MIDI channels.

steps.title: Widen the window at a loop boundary
steps.caption: Apply Window 2 while playing, then cancel a later draft. Every complete loop is either the old or new pattern; the accepted queue persists and eventually removes step 7 as well.

steps.title: The refused leader chain changes nothing
steps.caption: Trying to make the leader follow its own follower reports INVALID CHANNEL IS A LEADER. After discarding the refused draft, exact MIDI confirms that Window 2 still applies.

scenes.title: Give anchor notes a shared chord

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Use chord group one
steps.caption: Enable a C/E/G Harmony group, then choose Structure markers ANCHORS. The Chord group row names group 1.

steps.title: Anchors snap to the nearest chord pitch
steps.caption: Two loops verify MIDI anchors 60, 60, 64, 64 instead of 60, 62, 64, 65. Equal-distance choices go lower. The step-5 and step-7 additions retain their own pitches and accent.

steps.title: See who deletion affects
steps.caption: Deleting the referenced group opens a confirmation and names channel 1 as affected.

steps.title: Deletion restores authored pitches
steps.caption: Confirming deletion turns Markers OFF in the same transaction. Exact loops restore the authored 60/62/64/65 anchors while keeping the additions.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Revoice preserves the two pitch classes
steps.caption: After adding one chord-mask voice and applying Revoice, two loops emit paired MIDI pitches 48/50, 50/52, 52/53 and 53/55. Each pair retains its source velocity; Stop leaves no active notes.

scenes.title: Share a voicing while keeping each channel’s rhythm

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Four roles, independent rhythms
steps.caption: Four explicit member channels retain their sparse rhythms and velocities while Ensemble assigns MIDI pitches 48, 55, 64 and 67. Each channel’s onset interval is checked independently.

steps.title: A conflicting local scale uses the ordinary path
steps.caption: A local scale lock on channel 2 makes its five tested notes emit MIDI 64. Result names the reason exactly: LOCAL SCALE BYPASS.

steps.title: A local octave also names its bypass
steps.caption: Channel 3’s local octave produces six tested MIDI-72 notes through the ordinary path. Inspecting step 2 shows LOCAL OCTAVE BYPASS on Result.
